events.title: Supreme Court vacates stay in Steven Aiello v. United States
events.summary: The Supreme Court, through Associate Justice Sonia Sotomayor, vacated a previously issued stay in the case of Steven Aiello, et al. v. United States. The application for a stay, which had been issued on January 22, 2025, was denied in all respects. This decision means that the lower court's ruling will remain in effect while the case proceeds.
events.why_relevant: The vacating of the stay allows the lower court's decision to take effect, impacting the progression of the case.

events.title: Certiorari Denied in Nelson v. Texas
events.summary: The Supreme Court denied the application for a stay of execution and the petition for a writ of certiorari in the case of Steven L. Nelson v. Texas. The application was initially presented to Justice Alito, who referred it to the full Court. The denial means that the execution of the death sentence will proceed as scheduled.
events.why_relevant: The denial of certiorari and stay of execution affects the administration of justice and the finality of capital punishment cases.

events.title: Dept. of Ed., et al. v. Career Colleges and Sch. of TX briefing schedule held in abeyance
events.summary: The Supreme Court granted the motion of the Acting Solicitor General to hold the briefing schedule in abeyance in the case of Dept. of Ed., et al. v. Career Colleges and Schools of Texas. This procedural action pauses the briefing process, delaying further proceedings in this case.
events.why_relevant: This order affects the timeline and progression of a case involving the Department of Education, impacting how and when the case will proceed.
